# The record of the commands Grails 8 had: every command of the Grails shell (grails-shell-cli) and of its profiles
# (grails-profiles), which Grails 9 does not have. It was written once, from the sources of the shell and of the
# profiles as they were before they were removed, and is not regenerated: there is nothing left to read it from.
# FormerCommandsSpec holds that each name is a command of the command line or has a line in the table of FormerCommands.
# The name of the command, a tab, and where it was:
#   shell               a command class the shell registered (META-INF/services/org.grails.cli.profile.Command)
#   shell-interactive   a word the interactive mode of the shell took besides commands
#   profile:<profile>   a file commands/<name>.yml or commands/<name>.groovy of that profile
#   profile:<profile>:synonym-of:<command>   another name the script of that command gave itself (synonyms)
